# laravelcloud_database_clusters (Resource)

Manages a database cluster in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_database_clusters" "example" {
  name   = "example-name"
  region = "us-east-2"
  # The API reports the engine without its version ("laravel_mysql"). A
  # versioned type such as "laravel_mysql_84" is kept as configured.
  type = "laravel_mysql"

  # Settings depend on the type. Values are strings; booleans and numbers are
  # sent to the API as such.
  config = {
    size                     = "mysql-flex-512mb"
    storage                  = "5"
    is_public                = "false"
    uses_scheduled_snapshots = "true"
    retention_days           = "7"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Map of String) Configuration object. Fields vary based on database type.
- `name` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (Number)
- `database` (String) The database identifier

### Read-Only

- `connection_details` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_details))
- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_database_clusters.example the-id
```
